name: UNESCO Old Riga Medieval Architecture Walking Tour
description: You will wander through a labyrinth of cobblestone streets as a local guide uncovers centuries of history behind the House of the Blackheads, St. Peter's Church, and the Three Brothers complex. Scale the winding stairs of medieval towers to witness how German, Swedish, and Russian rules shaped the city's unique Baltic identity.
duration_note: Advance booking recommended during summer peak season; involves walking over uneven historical cobblestones.

name: Art Nouveau Architecture Deep Dive in the Quiet Centre
description: You will explore Alberta Street and Elizabetes Street to gaze at Europe's highest concentration of Art Nouveau masterworks, featuring dramatic gargoyles, intricate blue tiles, and expressive stone faces. Step inside the Riga Art Nouveau Centre museum to experience an authentically restored 1903 apartment complete with period furniture and clothing.
duration_note: The museum is closed on Mondays; the architectural street viewing is free and accessible 24/7.

name: Smoked Fish and Rye Bread Tasting at Riga Central Market
description: You will step inside massive, converted WWI zeppelin hangars to sample authentic Latvian staples directly from local vendors. Bite into rich, dark rye bread (Rupjmaize), sample hot-smoked Baltic herring and lamprey, and taste traditional hemp butter while navigating the bustling pavilions.
duration_note: Best visited in the morning before 13:00 when the fish and dairy pavilions are at their liveliest.

name: Black Balsam Mixology Masterclass at Black Magic Bar
description: You will step back into an 18th-century apothecary setting where Riga Black Balsam, Latvia's legendary herbal liqueur, was first brewed. Learn the secret history of its 24 botanicals from a costumed specialist, sample the traditional, black currant, and cherry varieties, and mix your own signature cocktail accompanied by handmade dark chocolate truffles.
duration_note: Requires minimum 48 hours advance booking; restricted to participants aged 18 and older.

name: Underground Folk Music and Craft Beer Night at Folkklubs Ala Pagrabs
description: You will descend into an expansive, ancient wine cellar to immerse yourself in Riga's premier local nightlife hub. Dance alongside locals to live Latvian folk-rock bands, choose from over 30 local craft beers on tap, and refuel with massive portions of traditional grey peas with bacon.
duration_note: Extremely crowded on Friday and Saturday nights; table reservations are highly recommended if you plan to eat.

name: Sunset Cocktails Over the City Skyline at Skyline Bar
description: You will ride a glass elevator up to the 26th floor of the Radisson Blu to experience breathtaking 360-degree views of Riga's old church spires and the Daugava River. Sip expertly crafted contemporary cocktails as local DJs set the vibe, watching the city shift from golden hour to a sea of glittering night lights.
duration_note: Cover charge applies on Friday and Saturday evenings after 21:00; smart casual dress code enforced.

name: Authentic Baltic Amber Sourcing and Polishing Workshop
description: You will meet a master artisan in a hidden Old Town workshop to learn how to identify genuine 50-million-year-old Baltic amber from fakes. Select a raw piece of unpolished amber and use traditional sanding and polishing wheels to bring out its deep golden brilliance, creating your own custom pendant to take home.
duration_note: All tools and raw amber pieces are provided in the cost; family-friendly activity suitable for children over 8.

name: Sunset Kayaking Through Riga's Historic Canal and Daugava River
description: You will paddle a stable twin-kayak down the calm waters of the old city moat, gliding past the illuminated Latvian National Opera and the lush greenery of Bastejkalns Park. Pop out into the wide Daugava River just as the sun sets to capture spectacular, unobstructed photos of the iconic Riga castle and modern suspension bridges.
duration_note: Runs from May to September; life jackets are mandatory and provided; no previous kayaking experience required.

region: Jūrmala & the Gulf of Riga Coast
name: Wooden Architecture and Beach Front Promenade Walk
description: You will stroll past Jūrmala's famously preserved 19th-century Art Nouveau and Swiss-cottage style wooden summer houses nestled beneath towering pine trees. Walk down the vibrant, pedestrian-only Jomas iela before stepping onto the sprawling, white-quartz sand beach to catch the cool Baltic sea breeze.
duration_note: Entirely free outdoor activity; easily accessible via a 35-minute train ride from Riga Central Station.

region: Jūrmala & the Gulf of Riga Coast
name: Sunrise Boardwalk Trek Across the Great Ķemeri Bog
description: You will wake up before dawn to cross a surreal, mist-covered landscape of moss, stunted pine trees, and dark, glass-like peat pools. Walk along a wooden eco-trail to a multi-story viewing tower, where you will watch the sun rise and paint the pristine, prehistoric bog ecosystem in shades of brilliant orange and pink.
duration_note: Available year-round, but sunrise guided tours run from May to October; requires sturdy, waterproof footwear.

region: Jūrmala & the Gulf of Riga Coast
name: Amber Body Scrub and Baltic Mineral Therapy at Baltic Beach Spa
description: You will escape the seaside chill with an ultra-luxurious, culturally authentic wellness treatment utilizing crushed local Baltic amber. Relax during a full-body exfoliating scrub, soak in a heated sea-water pool pumped directly from the Gulf, and experience a therapeutic massage designed to improve circulation and melt away travel stress.
duration_note: Advance booking of at least 7 days is essential, especially for weekend afternoon slots.

region: Jūrmala & the Gulf of Riga Coast
name: Smoked Eel and Coastal Delicacies Savoring Tour
description: You will venture to a rustic fishermen's market on the edge of the coast where local families have smoked fresh catches for generations. Tear into hot, alder-smoked eel, flounder, and salmon seasoned with coarse salt and garlic, eating them fresh from greaseproof paper right on the wooden picnic benches.
duration_note: Requires private car or regional bus to reach from Jūrmala; vendors operate primarily from Thursday to Sunday.

region: Jūrmala & the Gulf of Riga Coast
name: Windsurfing and Stand-Up Paddleboarding at Lielupe Estuary
description: You will harness the steady winds where the Lielupe River meets the open Baltic Sea. Rent premium gear or take a one-on-one lesson with an experienced instructor to glide across the flat river waters, balancing as you take in sweeping views of the massive white sand dunes nearby.
duration_note: Seasonal activity running strictly from June to August; subject to daily wind conditions and safety checks.

region: Jūrmala & the Gulf of Riga Coast
name: Open-Air Symphony Night at the Historic Dzintari Concert Hall
description: You will dress up for an unforgettable evening of classical, jazz, or pop music under the stars in a world-famous, covered open-air acoustic wooden hall from 1936. Listen to world-class musicians perform while the soothing, rhythmic sound of ocean waves crashes through the pine forest just meters away.
duration_note: The open-air summer season runs from June to September; tickets for high-profile concerts sell out months in advance.

name: Adrenaline-Fueled Olympic Bobsleigh Bumping Ride
description: You will strap into a real, modified bobsled and hurtle down the icy or wheeled concrete tracks of an elite Olympic training facility. Experience gut-wrenching G-forces as a professional pilot steers you through 16 sharp, high-speed curves at speeds reaching up to 80 kilometers per hour.
duration_note: Winter bobsleigh runs on real ice (Nov-Mar); summer 'vučko' bobsleigh runs on wheels (May-Sep). Weight and health restrictions apply.

name: Medieval Castles and Livonian Heritage Exploration
description: You will climb to the top of the iconic red-brick Turaida Medieval Castle tower for an awe-inspiring vista of the ancient Gauja River valley. Explore the historic wooden church, wander through the mystical Folk Song Garden sculpture park, and learn the tragic local legend of the beautiful Rose of Turaida.
duration_note: Extensive outdoor walking over paths; entry fee decreases slightly during the off-season winter months.

name: Crimulda Cable Car Ziplining Over the Ancient Valley
description: You will step onto the only cable car in the Baltics, suspended 43 meters above the pristine Gauja River. For the ultimate thrill, brave participants can opt to secure into the 'Zērglis' zipline system to fly solo down the cable, reaching hair-raising speeds over the treetops.
duration_note: Ziplining operates primarily from May to October on Thursdays through Sundays; strictly weather-dependent.

name: Candlelit Medieval Torch Tour of Cēsis Castle Dungeon
description: You will step back into the year 1214 as you take a handheld canvas lantern and descend into the pitch-black stone chambers of Cēsis Medieval Castle. Climb narrow spiral staircases to view the Master's private quarters and explore the deep defensive prison cells with a guide clad in authentic medieval armor.
duration_note: Open year-round; the winding stone steps can be slippery and dark, requiring careful footwork and flat shoes.

name: Multi-Day Wilderness Canoeing down the Gauja Sandstone Cliffs
description: You will paddle a traditional open canoe down the gentle currents of the Gauja River, flanked by dramatic, multimillion-year-old red Devonian sandstone cliffs. Set up wild camps on pristine river beaches, cook meals over open campfires, and sleep beneath the stars surrounded by dense, unblemished wilderness.
duration_note: Includes canoe rental, lifejackets, and return shuttle transport; recommended from late May through early September.

name: Local Wild Berry and Fruit Wine Tasting inside Sandstone Caves
description: You will venture inside a labyrinth of hand-carved, candlelit 18th-century subterranean cellars in the historic papermaking village of Līgatne. Sample award-winning, small-batch craft wines fermented from local wild cranberries, cloudberries, rhubarb, and black currants by a passionate family-owned winery.
duration_note: The sandstone cellars stay a constant 8 degrees Celsius year-round; bringing a jacket or warm sweater is highly recommended.

name: Wild Eurasian Lynx and Brown Bear Wildlife Tracking Walk
description: You will trek through dense, old-growth forests along specially designed boardwalk paths to observe Latvia's native wildlife in their natural woodland habitats. Keep your eyes peeled to spot secretive Eurasian lynx, majestic elk, wild boars, and rescued brown bears roaming through large, safely fenced forested enclosures.
duration_note: Open daily; involves roughly 5 kilometers of walking over rolling, forested terrain; brilliant for families and photographers.

name: Exploring Gūtmaņala, the Baltics' Largest Historical Cave
description: You will stand inside the widest and highest cave in the Baltic states, marveling at the thousands of historical inscriptions and coats-of-arms etched into the red sandstone walls dating back to the 17th century. Drink from the clear natural spring water running through the cave, which ancient legends claim holds powerful healing properties.
duration_note: Free entry and open year-round; fully wheelchair accessible with flat paved walking paths leading straight from the visitor center parking.

name: Pilgrimage and Architecture Tour of the Aglona Basilica
description: You will view the magnificent, towering white towers of Latvia's most important sacred site, an iconic 18th-century Baroque shrine that welcomes hundreds of thousands of pilgrims annually. Walk the echoing, cavernous interior to view a collection of priceless sacred art and the miraculously reputed icon of the Holy Mother of God of Aglona.
duration_note: Admission is free, but donations are appreciated. Dress respectfully, covering shoulders and knees when entering the sacred sanctuary.

name: Exploring the Mark Rothko Art Centre inside an Empire-Style Fortress
description: You will explore the sprawling, atmospheric ramparts of Europe's last remaining intact 19th-century military fortress complex. Step inside the beautifully converted artillery arsenal building to view rare, original multi-million dollar abstract expressionist masterpieces by world-renowned artist Mark Rothko in his birthplace.
duration_note: Closed on Mondays; guided historical fortress tours outside on the ramparts can be booked separately at the visitor counter.

name: Black Ceramics Clay-Throwing Masterclass with a Latgalian Master
description: You will get your hands dirty in a traditional rural pottery workshop under the guidance of an authentic Latgalian craftsman. Learn the prehistoric Baltic technique of firing pots in an underground kiln using wood smoke, creating a unique, metallic-black ceramic cup or bowl using your own hands.
duration_note: Booking at least 5 days in advance is required; your finished ceramic piece must dry and bake, meaning it will be shipped to your home address later.

name: Sailing Cruise Across Lake Rāzna, the Latgalian Sea
description: You will board a sleek, modern sailboat to navigate the expansive waters of Latvia's second-largest lake, affectionately known as the Latgalian Sea due to its sweeping horizons. Relax on the sun deck as you glide past pristine sandy beaches, pine forests, and traditional, remote wooden fishing villages.
duration_note: Sailing excursions operate from June through early September; completely dependent on daily lake wind and weather safety conditions.

name: Traditional Rye Bread Baking and Culinary Heritage Feast
description: You will step inside a fragrant, wood-fired bakery at the Aglona Bread Museum to learn the sacred traditions of Latvian bread making. Knead your own mini-loaf of dark rye, slide it into the brick oven using a long wooden paddle, and enjoy a hearty traditional lunch of Latgalian potato pies (Asuškas) and local herbal moonshine (Šmakovka).
duration_note: Advance reservations required via phone or email; the museum host offers lively, theatrical storytelling during the meal.

name: Nature Exploration and Wild Swimming at Teirumnīki Bog Trail
description: You will walk down a scenic, short wooden boardwalk winding through pristine cranberry fields and specialized wetlands. Reach the deep, dark waters of Lake Teirumnīks, where you can strip down and plunge into the pure, soft, mineral-rich bog water for an incredibly refreshing wild swimming experience.
duration_note: Free public natural trail; equipped with a sturdy wooden swimming platform and changing cabin; bring your own towel.

name: Scenic Mountain Biking Along the Ancient Daugava River Meanders
description: You will rent a rugged mountain bike and pedal along the dramatic, sweeping bends of the Daugava River valley near the Belarus border. Cycle up steep clay bluffs to hidden viewpoints like the Vasargališki Observation Tower, taking in panoramic vistas of the ancient river route once depicted on old Latvian banknotes.
duration_note: Trails include steep ascents and descents on gravel paths; bike and helmet rental included from the local nature center.

name: Extreme Military Prison Experience and Overnight Lockdown
description: You will step into a dark, unyielding world inside the Tsarist-era Karosta Military Prison, the only military jail in Europe open to tourists. Experience intense interactive roleplay with guards acting in historical characters, navigate pitch-black subterranean labyrinth tunnels, and choose to sleep on a hard wooden bunk inside an authentic prison cell.
duration_note: The overnight stay requires signing a strict psychological and physical liability waiver form; operates from May to September.

name: Exploring the Haunting Concrete Northern Forts Ruins
description: You will walk along a wild, windswept Baltic beach where massive, blown-up Tsarist concrete naval bunkers are slowly collapsing directly into the crashing surf. Explore the eerie, hollowed-out artillery batteries and tunnels, which present a dramatic, post-apocalyptic scene that is an absolute paradise for urban exploration and photography.
duration_note: Free to explore independently at any hour; flashlights are essential for checking dark inner tunnels; exercise caution due to crumbling concrete structures.

name: Gothic Architecture and Organ Performance at Holy Trinity Cathedral
description: You will admire the striking, late-Baroque architecture before stepping inside to marvel at the cathedral's breathtaking, gold-leaf interior. Listen to the awe-inspiring power of the world's largest unreconstructed mechanical pipe organ, which features over 7,000 pipes and delivers an unforgettable acoustic experience.
duration_note: Special short organ music showcase concerts are held on regular schedule at 12:00 noon every Saturday from June to September.

name: Traditional Liepājas Menciņi Baked Cod Dining Experience
description: You will sit down at a historic, seaside brick warehouse restaurant to savor Liepāja's signature culinary creation. Dig into an aromatic, piping-hot clay pot filled with smoked Baltic cod, tender potatoes, onions, and rich cream, slow-baked to perfection according to an exclusive old coastal recipe.
duration_note: Available year-round; pairing the hot fish dish with a cold glass of local Užavas amber lager is highly recommended.

name: Late-Night Beach Party and Live Rock Gig at Fontaine Palace
description: You will dive straight into Liepāja's proud musical heritage at this famous, gritty rock club housed inside an old canal-side warehouse. Rock out to international live bands and local alternative DJs, then join the energetic crowds drifting out onto the sandy shores to party until the sunrise lights up the Baltic horizon.
duration_note: Club doors open late; headline live music acts typically don't take the stage until well after midnight on weekends.

name: Baltic Storm Windsurfing and Surfing Clinic at Pāvilosta Coast
description: You will travel to Latvia's undisputed adventure capital for wave-riding on the rugged west coast. Suit up in a thick neoprene wetsuit and master the challenging Baltic swells with a professional instructor, learning to surf or windsurf over flat sandbanks where the conditions are ideal for testing your limits.
duration_note: Wetsuit and high-end board equipment rental are fully included in the price; the most consistent, exciting surfing waves occur from late August through October.

name: Witnessing the Flying Fish Phenomenon at Ventas Rumba Waterfall
description: You will stand beside the Venta Rapid, proudly holding the title of Europe's widest natural waterfall at a massive 249 meters across. Watch in amazement as schools of native Baltic salmon and vimba bream attempt to leap high into the air over the cascading ledger, swimming upstream to reach their historical spawning grounds.
duration_note: The famous fish-jumping phenomenon occurs exclusively during spring spawning season from mid-April through May. Viewing is free.

name: Witnessing the Collision of Two Seas at Windswept Cape Kolka
description: You will stand at the extreme northern geographic tip of the Kurzeme peninsula, where the turbulent open Baltic Sea forcefully clashes directly with the calmer waves of the Gulf of Riga. Explore the haunting forest of pine trees killed by saltwater, and look out over dangerous shifting underwater sandbanks marked by a distant offshore lighthouse island.
location: Cape Kolka Visitor Center, Dundaga Space
duration_note: Remote wilderness site best accessed via rental car; entry to the beach is free, but there is a nominal fee for the main visitor parking lot.

name: Saturday Crafts and Artisanal Food Market in a Restored Wooden District
description: You will spend a lively morning browsing through a beautifully restored cluster of 19th-century wooden buildings. Meet independent Baltic jewelry designers, purchase handmade wool knitwear, and feast on artisanal cheeses, seasonal cloudberry jams, and hot potato pancakes prepared fresh by local farmers right in front of you.
duration_note: The market operates strictly on Saturdays from 10:00 to 16:00 year-round; admission is entirely free.

name: Soviet Bunkers and Cold War History Secret Military Tour
description: You will travel back behind the Iron Curtain on an immersive tour detailing Riga's complex 20th-century history under Soviet rule. Explore hidden civil defense bunkers built deep underground for Soviet elites, view monolithic brutalist architecture monument zones, and listen to gripping personal accounts of everyday life during the Cold War occupation era.
duration_note: Requires advance booking; tour involves heading underground into confined spaces and walking over dusty, industrial terrain.

region: Jūrmala & the Gulf of Riga Coast
name: High-Ropes Obstacle Climbing Course in the Pine Tree Treetops
description: You will strap into a full safety harness to tackle adrenaline-pumping aerial paths built into Jūrmala's magnificent, 200-year-old pine forest canopy. Test your balance across shaking suspension bridges, tightropes, and cargo nets, culminating in an exhilarating 100-meter zipline descent flying high above the forest floor.
duration_note: Operates from May to October; requires basic physical fitness; safety briefing and climbing gear are fully provided by track marshals.

name: Traditional Latvian Pirts Sauna Ritual with Birch Twig Beating
description: You will experience a deeply cultural, multi-hour wellness purification ritual inside a traditional wood-fired log cabin sauna. Guided by an authentic pirts master, you will sweat out toxins, endure therapeutic body slapping using fragrant wet birch and oak branch bundles (slotas), and plunge directly into a freezing natural spring pond.
duration_note: Private experience requiring booking weeks ahead; includes local herbal tea tasting to restore mineral balance; not advised for travelers with cardiovascular conditions.

name: Northern Pike and Perch Midnight Fishing Expedition
description: You will head out onto the glassy waters of a crystal-clear glacier lake under the eerie, luminous glow of a midsummer night. Guided by an expert local angler, learn how to cast lines and troll for hard-fighting trophy Northern Pike and giant European Perch, cooking your fresh catch in a rich fish soup on a campfire at dawn.
duration_note: Runs from June to August; involves overnight hours; specialized fishing rods, permits, and protective wet-weather gear are provided.

name: Bicycle Coastal Cruising Along the White Sand Blue Flag Beach
description: You will hop on a cruiser bicycle to navigate Europe's widest seaside park, tracking dedicated paths alongside pristine sand dunes. Admire historical wooden villas, stop to take photos next to the giant 'Liepāja' letters monument, and pedal effortlessly on the ultra-firm sand of the shoreline right next to the breaking waves.
duration_note: Bike rental shops operate from May to September; paths are entirely flat, wide, and brilliantly suited for all fitness levels.
